headline: Palantine Berm Swings to Colonials as Weathered Expanse Works Slip Away
war_summary:
Palantine Berm has turned since the last edition, its ledger now reading five Colonial works to two Warden and none unclaimed, where a slim Warden majority stood three hours past. Fifty-three ownership actions were tallied there in the day and nine in the final two, chiefly around Vendett and Windburn Landing, with casualties near even at better than three thousand six hundred a side in twenty-four hours.

In Weathered Expanse the Warden count has fallen from seven works to six, three now lying unclaimed; forty-nine actions in the day and eight in the last two continue about Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, and its rolls remain the war's heaviest at some six thousand three hundred Colonial and nearly seven thousand Warden in a day.

Linn Mercy's lone Warden work is gone, leaving nine Colonial and two neutral, with thirty-six actions in the day and eight in two hours pressing Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Stonecradle stands two Warden works against seven Colonial on twenty-one actions, and Stlican Shelf has stirred again with five actions in six hours, its two Warden works facing seven Colonial. Marban Hollow's twenty-nine actions lie almost wholly at Checkpoint Bua, the count unchanged at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. The victory requirement stands at thirty-four towns.
